dialogues.jp: 「う〜、かったりぃ」
dialogues.en: "What a pain."
dialogues.text: "What a pain."

dialogues.jp:
机の上にへばりながら、今日の昼飯のことを考
える。
dialogues.en: I covered the desk with my body, thinking about lunch.
dialogues.text: I covered the desk with my body, thinking about lunch.

dialogues.jp:
「買って食うにしろなんにしろ、食堂にいかな
　あかんのは面倒だな……」
dialogues.en:
"It's too much trouble to go to the cafeteria to buy
lunch..."
dialogues.text:
"It's too much trouble to go to the cafeteria to buy
lunch..."

dialogues.jp:
やはり自分は教室に残りつつ、誰かにパンと飲
み物を買って来てもらうのが無難な線だろう。
dialogues.en:
The best plan is to stay in the classroom, while I get
somebody else to go to the store and buy me a sandwich and a
drink.
dialogues.text:
The best plan is to stay in the classroom, while I get
somebody else to go to the store and buy me a sandwich and a
drink.

dialogues.jp:
えーと、杉並はいないし……だいたいの食堂組
も俺が寝ている間に消えているな。
dialogues.en:
Let's see, Suginami's gone, and all the guys who go to the
cafeteria are gone while I was sleeping...
dialogues.text:
Let's see, Suginami's gone, and all the guys who go to the
cafeteria are gone while I was sleeping...

dialogues.jp:
と、机でまだなにか書き物をしている音夢を発
見する。
dialogues.en: Then, I found Nemu at her desk writing something.
dialogues.text: Then, I found Nemu at her desk writing something.

dialogues.jp:
あー、あいつきちきちとしているけど、ちょっ
と要領悪いからな……これから食料の買いだし
に行くかもしれない。
dialogues.en:
She's quite organized but she's a little slow. Maybe she'll
go to the cafeteria now.
dialogues.text:
She's quite organized but she's a little slow. Maybe she'll
go to the cafeteria now.

dialogues.jp: 「おーい、音夢」
dialogues.en: "Hey, Nemu."
dialogues.text: "Hey, Nemu."

dialogues.jp:
あわよくば買ってきてもらおうと、音夢の肩を
たたく。
dialogues.en: I pat her shoulder hoping to make her go to the cafeteria.
dialogues.text: I pat her shoulder hoping to make her go to the cafeteria.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ん、どうしました兄さん？」
dialogues.en: "What? How can I help you?"
dialogues.text: "What? How can I help you?"

dialogues.jp: なんだか、えらく真面目に振り向かれる。
dialogues.en: She turned around all serious.
dialogues.text: She turned around all serious.

dialogues.jp: 「いや、昼飯どうするんだ？」
dialogues.en: "Well, what are you going to do about lunch?"
dialogues.text: "Well, what are you going to do about lunch?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「あぁ……そうだなぁ。食堂行くのも面倒なん
　だよね」
dialogues.en:
"Right... Let's see. It's too much trouble to go to the
cafeteria, don't you think?"
dialogues.text:
"Right... Let's see. It's too much trouble to go to the
cafeteria, don't you think?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "Huh?"
dialogues.text: "Huh?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「いやだ、勘違いしないでくださいね。お腹も
　あまり空いてないんですよ。ご飯食べると午
　後も眠くなるし」
dialogues.en:
"Oh, no, don't misunderstand me. I'm not that hungry
anyways. It makes me sleepy if I eat too much at lunch."
dialogues.text:
"Oh, no, don't misunderstand me. I'm not that hungry
anyways. It makes me sleepy if I eat too much at lunch."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「昼飯は食べないと身体に悪いぞ」
dialogues.en: "It's not good for you to skip lunch."
dialogues.text: "It's not good for you to skip lunch."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「う〜ん、そうなんだけどね」
dialogues.en: "You're right..."
dialogues.text: "You're right..."

dialogues.jp:
ノートを手でさすりながら音夢が首をかしげた。
と、その中身が先の授業ではないものに気づく。
dialogues.en:
Nemu tilted her head as she stroked the notebook, and I
realized that the note wasn't for the class.
dialogues.text:
Nemu tilted her head as she stroked the notebook, and I
realized that the note wasn't for the class.

dialogues.jp: 「それ、なにやってるんだ？」
dialogues.en: "What are you doing?"
dialogues.text: "What are you doing?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「え、テスト勉強だよ」
dialogues.en: "What? I'm studying for the test."
dialogues.text: "What? I'm studying for the test."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「兄さんもきちんとやらないとね。今回は皆あ
　んまりがんばってないみたいだから、上を狙
　えるよ」
dialogues.en:
"You should do the same, niisan. It seems like not too many
students are studying for the test, so maybe you can score
high this time."
dialogues.text:
"You should do the same, niisan. It seems like not too many
students are studying for the test, so maybe you can score
high this time."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「どうしたの？」
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「いや……腹が減ったからなにか買ってくる」
dialogues.en: "Nothing... I'm going to get something to eat."
dialogues.text: "Nothing... I'm going to get something to eat."

dialogues.jp:
額をおさえて｛うめ／呻｝く。このままここで音夢と話し
ていても、勉強の話しか出てきそうにない。
dialogues.en:
I placed my hand on my forehead. She'll probably keep
talking about the exam if I stay here longer.
dialogues.text:
I placed my hand on my forehead. She'll probably keep
talking about the exam if I stay here longer.

dialogues.jp:
と言うか……こいつ、テスト期間はあんまし遊
んでくれそうにないな。
dialogues.en:
Then I realized she won't hang out with me much during the
exam week.
dialogues.text:
Then I realized she won't hang out with me much during the
exam week.

dialogues.jp:
「なんかいるか？　少しでも食べておいたほう
　がいいぞ」
dialogues.en: "Do you want something? You should eat at least a little."
dialogues.text: "Do you want something? You should eat at least a little."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「あ、ほんと？　やった♪」
dialogues.en: "Are you sure? So lucky!"
dialogues.text: "Are you sure? So lucky!"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「え、やった？」
dialogues.en: "What? Lucky?"
dialogues.text: "What? Lucky?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「誰かに頼もうかなと思ってたんだけど、ノー
　トに気をとられてたら皆出てっちゃった後で」
dialogues.en:
"I wanted to ask someone, but I was too busy concentrating
on my notes, everybody was gone already."
dialogues.text:
"I wanted to ask someone, but I was too busy concentrating
on my notes, everybody was gone already."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……そないか」

ため息をつきつつ、それと同じくらいやる気の
ない足取りで教室を出ようとする。
dialogues.en: I sighed and I dragged myself out of the classroom.
dialogues.text: I sighed and I dragged myself out of the classroom.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「どうしたの兄さん？」
dialogues.en: "What's wrong?"
dialogues.text: "What's wrong?"

dialogues.jp: ん、と振り返る。
dialogues.en: I turned around.
dialogues.text: I turned around.

dialogues.jp:
「……いや、ミイラとりがミイラになっただけ
　だ」
dialogues.en: "......go for wool and come home shorn......"
dialogues.text: "......go for wool and come home shorn......"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「なに言ってるんです？」
dialogues.en: "What are you talking about?"
dialogues.text: "What are you talking about?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「気にするな」
dialogues.en: "Never mind."
dialogues.text: "Never mind."

dialogues.jp: 軽く手を振って廊下に出た。
dialogues.en: I waved a little and stepped out to the hallway.
dialogues.text: I waved a little and stepped out to the hallway.

dialogues.jp: 「なんで俺が買いだしに行くことに……」
dialogues.en: "Why do I have to go......"
dialogues.text: "Why do I have to go......"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「はいはい」
dialogues.en: "Okay, fine."
dialogues.text: "Okay, fine."

dialogues.jp:
ふと、人生の苦悩にさいなまれていると、呆れ
顔の音夢が隣に立っていた。
dialogues.en: As I was feeling crappy, I found Nemu by my side.
dialogues.text: As I was feeling crappy, I found Nemu by my side.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「もぅ、音夢さんも一緒に行ってあげるから、
　そんな寂しそうにしないでくださいよ」
dialogues.en: "Don't be so sad, I'll go with you."
dialogues.text: "Don't be so sad, I'll go with you."

dialogues.jp: 俺の頬に手を伸ばして、にこり、と微笑む。
dialogues.en: She smiled at me reaching out her hand to my cheek.
dialogues.text: She smiled at me reaching out her hand to my cheek.

dialogues.jp: 「……べ、別に寂しそうになんてしてねぇよ」
dialogues.en: "......I'm not sad."
dialogues.text: "......I'm not sad."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「そう？　ふーん」
dialogues.en: "Really? Huh."
dialogues.text: "Really? Huh."

dialogues.jp:
ちょん、と先に進んで音夢が、スカートを翻し
て振り返る。
dialogues.en:
She turned around, flaring her skirt as she walked in front
me.
dialogues.text:
She turned around, flaring her skirt as she walked in front
me.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「そういうことにしておいてあげるよ」
dialogues.en: "Then, let it be."
dialogues.text: "Then, let it be."

dialogues.jp:
音夢が行くなら俺は教室に残れるが、こいつは、
俺が行かなかったらやっぱり行かないんだろう
な。
dialogues.en:
I can stay in the classroom now that she's going to the
cafeteria, but if I did that, I bet she wouldn't go either.
dialogues.text:
I can stay in the classroom now that she's going to the
cafeteria, but if I did that, I bet she wouldn't go either.

dialogues.jp: 「仕方ないか」
dialogues.en: "That's too bad."
dialogues.text: "That's too bad."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「なんです？」
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「兄妹だからな」
dialogues.en: "You're my sister."
dialogues.text: "You're my sister."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "? ......Yeah, sure!"
dialogues.text: "? ......Yeah, sure!"

dialogues.jp:
なんだかご機嫌の音夢を隣に、食堂までの長い
長い道のりを、思ったよりは長く感じずに歩い
た。
dialogues.en:
I walked to the cafeteria with a happy Nemu at my side, and
the distance to the cafeteria seemed to be shorter than
usual.
dialogues.text:
I walked to the cafeteria with a happy Nemu at my side, and
the distance to the cafeteria seemed to be shorter than
usual.

dialogues.jp: ◆ミイラとりがミイラに◆
dialogues.en: ◆Go for wool and come home shorn◆
dialogues.text: ◆Go for wool and come home shorn◆

dialogues.jp:
昼飯を買いに行くのがかったるい。そう思って、
まだ教室にいた音夢に声をかけたのだが……。
dialogues.en:
I don't feel like going to buy lunch. So I talked to Nemu
who was still in the classroom at the time.
dialogues.text:
I don't feel like going to buy lunch. So I talked to Nemu
who was still in the classroom at the time.

dialogues.jp:
結局、音夢とふたりで買いに行くことになって
しまった。
dialogues.en: But we ended up going to the cafeteria together.
dialogues.text: But we ended up going to the cafeteria together.
